# Test: Rollback from split-rootfs v2 back to split-rootfs v1 when Adam is unreachable
# Scenario: split(v1) -> split(v2) -> controller disconnect -> rollback to split(v1)
#
# Precondition: device is already running a good split-rootfs EVE v1
#   (for example after update_eve_image_split).
#
# This test verifies rollback when the new split image is otherwise healthy:
# the new Core activates on the other slot, the new Extension is mounted,
# services are running, and then host-side traffic from EVE to Adam is
# dropped. nodeagent detects controller unreachability, the fallback timeout
# expires, and the device rolls back to the previous good split slot.
#
# Env vars:
#   EVE_VERSION   - current good split-rootfs v1 tag (required)
#   EVE_VERSION_2 - next good split-rootfs v2 tag (required)
#   EVE_REGISTRY  - OCI registry path (default: lfedge/eve)

{{$rollback_ver := "0.0.0"}}
{{$target_ver := "0.0.0"}}
{{$eve_registry := "lfedge/eve"}}

{{$env_v1 := EdenGetEnv "EVE_VERSION"}}
{{if $env_v1}}{{$rollback_ver = $env_v1}}{{end}}

{{$env_v2 := EdenGetEnv "EVE_VERSION_2"}}
{{if $env_v2}}{{$target_ver = $env_v2}}{{end}}

{{$env_reg := EdenGetEnv "EVE_REGISTRY"}}
{{if $env_reg}}{{$eve_registry = $env_reg}}{{end}}

{{$eve_hv := "kvm"}}
{{$eve_arch := EdenConfig "eve.arch"}}
{{$rollback_short := printf "%s-%s-%s" $rollback_ver $eve_hv $eve_arch}}
{{$target_short := printf "%s-%s-%s" $target_ver $eve_hv $eve_arch}}
{{$test_info := "test eden.lim.test -test.v -timewait 30m -test.run TestInfo"}}

# ── Step 1: Verify current split state ───────────────────────
message 'Split->Split disconnect rollback: verifying current split state...'
eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'split'

message 'Split->Split disconnect rollback: waiting for current Extension mount...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-extsloader.sh

# ── Step 2: Send OTA to good split v2 ────────────────────────
message 'Split->Split disconnect rollback: ensuring no stale host drop is present...'
exec bash cleanup-adam-drop.sh

eden controller edge-node update --config timer.test.baseimage.update=600
eden controller edge-node update --config timer.update.fallback.no.network=60
eden controller edge-node update --config timer.send.timeout=10

message 'Split->Split disconnect rollback: sending split v2 update...'
eden -t 10m controller edge-node eveimage-update oci://docker.io/{{$eve_registry}}:{{$target_ver}}-{{$eve_hv}}-{{$eve_arch}} -m adam://
! stderr .

# ── Step 3: Wait for split v2 boot (inprogress) and Extension ──
message 'Split->Split disconnect rollback: waiting for split v2 to boot (inprogress)...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:inprogress InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $target_short }}'
stdout '{{ $target_short }}'

message 'Split->Split disconnect rollback: waiting for Extension services (SSH)...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-ssh.sh

message 'Split->Split disconnect rollback: waiting for Extension mount...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-extsloader.sh

eden eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo mounted || echo not-mounted'
stdout 'mounted'

eden eve ssh 'ls /dev/mapper/exts-verity-* 2>/dev/null && echo verity-active || echo no-verity'
stdout 'verity-active'

message 'Split->Split disconnect rollback: split v2 is healthy, blocking Adam next...'

# ── Step 4: Block EVE -> Adam on the host ────────────────────
message 'Split->Split disconnect rollback: blocking EVE -> Adam on the host for 150s...'
exec bash disconnect-window.sh 150

# ── Step 5: Wait for rollback to split v1 ────────────────────
message 'Split->Split disconnect rollback: waiting for split v1 to become active again...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:active InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $rollback_short }}'
stdout '{{ $rollback_short }}'

# ── Step 6: Wait for SSH and verify rollback state ───────────
message 'Split->Split disconnect rollback: waiting for SSH after rollback...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-ssh.sh

message 'Split->Split disconnect rollback: verifying rolled back split state...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-extsloader.sh

eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'split'

eden eve ssh 'echo alive'
stdout 'alive'

eden eve ssh 'count=$(ls /persist/ext-img*.img 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "ext-img-count:$count"'
stdout 'ext-img-count:1'

eden eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo mounted || echo not-mounted'
stdout 'mounted'

eden eve ssh 'ls /dev/mapper/exts-verity-* 2>/dev/null && echo verity-active || echo no-verity'
stdout 'verity-active'

message 'Split->Split disconnect rollback: SUCCESS'

# Test's config file
-- eden-config.yml --
test:
    controller: adam://{{EdenConfig "adam.ip"}}:{{EdenConfig "adam.port"}}
    eve:
      {{EdenConfig "eve.name"}}:
        onboard-cert: {{EdenConfigPath "eve.cert"}}
        serial: "{{EdenConfig "eve.serial"}}"
        model: {{EdenConfig "eve.devmodel"}}

-- wait-ssh.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do
    if timeout 10 $EDEN eve ssh echo ssh-ready 2>/dev/null; then
        exit 0
    fi
    sleep 5
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "SSH not available after 150s"
exit 1

-- wait-extsloader.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 24 ]; do
    MOUNTED=$($EDEN eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo yes || echo no' 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$MOUNTED" = "yes" ]; then
        echo "Extension mounted at /persist/exts"
        exit 0
    fi
    echo "Waiting for Extension mount (attempt $((i+1))/24)..."
    sleep 10
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "Extension not mounted after 240s"
exit 1

-- disconnect-window.sh --
set -eu

CHAIN=DOCKER-USER
OUTPUT_CHAIN=OUTPUT
COMMENT_FWD=eden-update-split-to-split-disconnect-fwd
COMMENT_OUT=eden-update-split-to-split-disconnect-out
ADAM_CONTAINER_IP=$(docker inspect eden_adam | awk -F'"' '/"IPAddress": "[0-9]/{print $4; exit}')
ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT=8080
RULE_FWD=(-p tcp -d "$ADAM_CONTAINER_IP" --dport "$ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT" -m comment --comment "$COMMENT_FWD" -j DROP)
RULE_OUT=(-p tcp -d "$ADAM_CONTAINER_IP" --dport "$ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT" -m comment --comment "$COMMENT_OUT" -j DROP)
WAIT_SECONDS="${1:-150}"

if [ -z "$ADAM_CONTAINER_IP" ]; then
    echo "failed to resolve eden_adam container IP"
    exit 1
fi

if ! sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "passwordless sudo or a cached sudo session is required for iptables; run 'sudo -v' before this test"
    exit 1
fi

if ! sudo -n iptables -w -nL "$CHAIN" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "iptables chain $CHAIN is not available"
    exit 1
fi

if ! sudo -n iptables -w -nL "$OUTPUT_CHAIN" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "iptables chain $OUTPUT_CHAIN is not available"
    exit 1
fi

cleanup() {
    bash cleanup-adam-drop.sh
}

trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

echo "Blocking Adam container endpoint ${ADAM_CONTAINER_IP}:${ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT}"

if sudo -n iptables -w -C "$CHAIN" "${RULE_FWD[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Host FORWARD DROP rule already present"
else
    echo "Adding host FORWARD DROP rule for Adam..."
    sudo -n iptables -w -I "$CHAIN" 1 "${RULE_FWD[@]}"
fi

if sudo -n iptables -w -C "$OUTPUT_CHAIN" "${RULE_OUT[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Host OUTPUT DROP rule already present"
else
    echo "Adding host OUTPUT DROP rule for Adam..."
    sudo -n iptables -w -I "$OUTPUT_CHAIN" 1 "${RULE_OUT[@]}"
fi

echo "Host DROP rule active for ${WAIT_SECONDS}s"
sleep "$WAIT_SECONDS"

-- cleanup-adam-drop.sh --
set -eu

CHAIN=DOCKER-USER
OUTPUT_CHAIN=OUTPUT
COMMENT_FWD=eden-update-split-to-split-disconnect-fwd
COMMENT_OUT=eden-update-split-to-split-disconnect-out
ADAM_CONTAINER_IP=$(docker inspect eden_adam | awk -F'"' '/"IPAddress": "[0-9]/{print $4; exit}')
ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT=8080
RULE_FWD=(-p tcp -d "$ADAM_CONTAINER_IP" --dport "$ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT" -m comment --comment "$COMMENT_FWD" -j DROP)
RULE_OUT=(-p tcp -d "$ADAM_CONTAINER_IP" --dport "$ADAM_CONTAINER_PORT" -m comment --comment "$COMMENT_OUT" -j DROP)

if [ -z "$ADAM_CONTAINER_IP" ]; then
    echo "failed to resolve eden_adam container IP"
    exit 1
fi

if ! sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "passwordless sudo or a cached sudo session is required for iptables; run 'sudo -v' before this test"
    exit 1
fi

if ! sudo -n iptables -w -nL "$CHAIN" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "iptables chain $CHAIN is not available"
    exit 1
fi

if ! sudo -n iptables -w -nL "$OUTPUT_CHAIN" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "iptables chain $OUTPUT_CHAIN is not available"
    exit 1
fi

while sudo -n iptables -w -C "$CHAIN" "${RULE_FWD[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    echo "Removing host FORWARD DROP rule for Adam..."
    sudo -n iptables -w -D "$CHAIN" "${RULE_FWD[@]}"
done

while sudo -n iptables -w -C "$OUTPUT_CHAIN" "${RULE_OUT[@]}" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    echo "Removing host OUTPUT DROP rule for Adam..."
    sudo -n iptables -w -D "$OUTPUT_CHAIN" "${RULE_OUT[@]}"
done

sleep 5
echo "Host DROP rule removed"
